title: Shoot the masterclasses in a studio
question: Where do we shoot the masterclasses?

frame.problem: Home shoots needed too much editing to fix sound and light, and editing is the slowest step. Where do we shoot the masterclasses?

vars.name: Editing time
vars.ctx: Editing takes 5 d per masterclass today; the target is 3 d.

vars.name: Cost per shoot
vars.ctx: A studio day costs about €450; the home setup is already paid for.

vars.name: Scheduling flexibility
vars.ctx: Ilya and the speakers need to book slots at least a week ahead in a studio.

opts.name: Rent a studio
opts.desc: Controlled light and sound, one day per masterclass.

opts.name: Upgrade the home setup
opts.desc: Buy lights and a microphone, keep shooting at home.

opts.name: Hybrid
opts.desc: Studio for the main sequences, home for the short inserts.
